senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בש, sec. r. of באש, cmp. בשם, בשש)to ripen, boil, be done (through natural or artificial heat).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 8:1:2">Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ הזרע וכ׳</he> when the seed boils inside (maturity of genital organs), the pot outside becomes dark (genitals are covered with hair).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95b:11">Snh. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>לבַשֵּׁל פירות</he> to make the fruits ripen.
<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:14">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>לא תְבַשֵּׁל וכ׳</he> cook not in a pot which thy neighbor has used before thee (i.e. marry not a divorced woman).—Part. Pu. <he>מְבוּשָּׁל</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:1">Ned. VI, 1</cite> <he>הנודר מן המב׳ וכ׳</he> he who vows abstinence from anything boiled, is permitted to partake of roasts &c.
Ib. 49ᵃ באתרא … קרו מב׳ in R. J.’s place they call roast likewise m’bushshal (cmp.
<cite ref="II Chronicles 35:13">II Chr. XXXV, 13</cite>); a. fr.

<cite ref="Sotah 11a">Sot. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:9">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>בקדרה שבשלו וכ׳</he> in the pot they boiled in, they were boiled, (they were done by as they did by others).
